hook: Transit timing of hot Jupiter TOI-2109 b hints at an unseen companion of 0.70 Jupiter masses
hook_turn: hints at an unseen companion of 0.70 Jupiter masses

readout.label: Amplitude of periodic transit timing signal

summary: Using 87 transits over two decades, the team tested five timing models and found no significant orbital decay. A periodic timing signal of about 44 seconds is best fit by a non-transiting planet near a 7:3 resonance. The preference over a simple sinusoid is modest (BIC difference 4.95), so the companion is a candidate, not a confirmed planet.
title: A Possible Non-Transiting Companion in the TOI-2109 System Supported by Transit Timing Variations
